infra.cost.ask.forecast: Will this month go over budget?
infra.cost.ask.month: What does this month cost, and why did it rise?
infra.cost.ask.waste: Which of these can I drop right now without breaking anything?
infra.cost.budget.emailsWhy: No address means no notification. The budget still shows its limit and spend here.
infra.cost.budget.noAccountId: The account id has not been resolved yet, and the Budgets API requires it. Run an identity check on the profile in Settings → Infrastructure.
infra.cost.budget.none: This account has no budget yet.
infra.cost.budget.thresholdWhy: Alerts fire at 80% and 100% of actual spend, not of the forecast — forecasts swing early in a period and raise false alarms. Editing an existing budget changes the limit only; AWS sets notifications through a separate call.
infra.cost.budget.title: Budgets
infra.cost.budget.why: AWS Budgets, read and written on the account itself — not something AWOG keeps.
infra.cost.check.ebs-unattached.label: Unattached EBS volume
infra.cost.check.ebs-unattached.why: A volume in the available state: no instance is using it, and it still bills per GB-month.
infra.cost.check.ec2-idle.label: Idle EC2 instance
infra.cost.check.ec2-idle.why: Average CPU below 3% for 14 days. Needs metrics, so this check costs money.
infra.cost.check.eip-idle.label: Idle Elastic IP
infra.cost.check.eip-idle.why: A static IP attached to nothing. AWS still bills it by the hour.
infra.cost.check.lb-no-targets.label: Load balancer with no targets
infra.cost.check.lb-no-targets.why: None of its target groups has a registered target. Still billed hourly.
infra.cost.check.logs-no-retention.label: Log group with no retention
infra.cost.check.logs-no-retention.why: Kept forever, so this one does not sit still — it grows every day.
infra.cost.check.nat-idle.label: NAT gateway with no traffic
infra.cost.check.nat-idle.why: Almost no bytes moved in 14 days. Needs metrics, so this check costs money.
infra.cost.check.snapshot-stale.label: Stale snapshot
infra.cost.check.snapshot-stale.why: Older than 90 days. Snapshots bill incrementally, so the figure shown is an upper bound.
infra.cost.month.priceWhy: Cost Explorer bills $0.01 per request; one load is 3. Cached for the rest of the day.
infra.cost.month.reloadWhy: Ignores today’s cache and pays for three more requests.
infra.cost.month.title: This month
infra.cost.noProfile: No AWS profile selected. Pick one in Settings → Infrastructure, or on the context bar.
infra.cost.noSidecar: The engine is not running, so nothing can be read.
infra.cost.subtitle: What this month costs so far, where it is heading, and what is burning money with nobody using it. Nothing here runs on its own — each block has its own button, and each one spends something.
infra.cost.tile.forecastWhy: Calculated by AWS, not by AWOG.
infra.cost.title: Cost
infra.cost.waste.clean: Nothing found by the checks you ran.
infra.cost.waste.paidWarn: {n} of the selected checks read CloudWatch metrics, which bills per metric × data point.
infra.cost.waste.pricingWhy: Estimates from list prices for {r}, taken {d}. Your contract, region and Savings Plans are not visible here.
infra.cost.waste.regionWhy: Region-scoped resources: this scan only sees {r}.
infra.cost.waste.title: Waste scan
infra.cost.waste.unpriced: and {n} with no price — see the column
